note: The committer view of the same chart: repositories where every resolved committer shares one employer. Because committer curation is thinner, more repos fall below the 'enough of the roster is known' bar and are left uncounted — treat this as a floor, not a total.
methodology: Same construction over each repository's committers — people with write access there and no maintainer seat anywhere.
Repos where unmapped committers outnumber resolved ones are never flagged, so thin curation under-counts rather than over-claims.
population: Repositories whose resolved committers share one employer. Independent and unresolved affiliations follow the diversity table's counting rules.
